user.title: Connect your Simple Touch bridge
user.description: Enter the ESP32 bridge address on your local network. Find its bridge key in the bridge web interface under Settings → Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge. Check its address and that Home Assistant can access its network.
error.wrong_bridge: This address belongs to a different bridge. Add it as a new integration.

init.title: Manage your shades
init.description:
[Open your bridge]({url}) to add shades, follow guided pairing, rename remotes, or download a backup. New paired shades appear here automatically.

Use Reconfigure from the integration menu to change its address or bridge key.
